task.pr_title: GLTFLoader: Prevents set data uri in texture.name.

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description: What is this `sourceDef.uri.length > 0` check for? And [`sourceDef.uri` is optional (if image data is defined in `sourceDef.bufferView`)](https://registry.khronos.org/glTF/specs/2.0/glTF-2.0.html#reference-image) so accessing `sourceDef.uri.length` can cause an exception in that case.
